name: Siyi.app: Remember People
subtitle: Never lose touch with friends
promotionalText: Write one sentence the day you meet someone. Siyi brings them back up when it matters—birthdays, favors you promised, friends gone quiet.
description:
Siyi.app helps you remember the people you meet and the context that makes the next conversation easier.

You meet more people in a month of college than in the years before it, and almost all of them fade by November. Not because you did not care—because meeting someone and keeping them are two different things.

Add someone in seconds with a name, Instagram username, phone number, where you met, and a short note. Add more whenever you learn something worth keeping.

Today keeps timely things in order: overdue follow-ups, upcoming birthdays, people you meant to check in with, and the newest people in your circle.

Use Siyi.app to:
• Save people quickly after meeting them
• Add fast updates after a conversation
• Keep useful context and notes together
• Add follow-ups with clear due dates
• See time since your last conversation
• Use relationship-based reminder intervals you control
• Search by name, contact detail, note, major, residence, or tag
• Work with cached people and queue changes while offline
• Export your information as JSON or CSV
• Delete your account and owned data from the app

Siyi.app is free. There are no streaks, social scores, public profiles, ads, or social-network scraping. Nobody you add is ever notified, and nothing you write is shown to anyone. Your records are private to your account.
